gov.extent: the countries of the world as Natural Earth defines them, distinguishing metropolitan portions from independent and semi-independent portions of sovereign states; rows per file, measured: 177 (1:110m), 242 (1:50m), 258 (1:10m)
gov.method: de facto boundaries according to who controls the territory (Natural Earth); disputed areas are tagged rather than resolved; shipped losslessly, nothing simplified or re-derived in this build
gov.resolution: three Natural Earth scales shipped as separate files: 1:110m, 1:50m and 1:10m
